name: Lumi

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 4-star Electro Broadblade Hybrid, the only character to buff Resonance Skill DMG on Outro (38%). Dual Forte gauge (Yellow Light Spark / Red Light Spark) toggled with no cooldown via her Resonance Skill, alternating ranged (Yellow Light) and melee (Red Light) stances.

skills.normalAttack: Yellow Light Basic (Squeakie ranged shots) / Red Light Basic (3-hit melee chain), both Electro.
skills.resonanceSkill: Pounce (Yellow->Red) / Rebound (Red->Yellow) - free stance swap with no cooldown.
skills.forte: Signal Light - at full Spark of the current stance, Energized Pounce/Rebound enters an empowered Red Spotlight/Yellow Spotlight Mode.
skills.liberation: Squeakie Express - throws giant Squeakie, Electro AoE DMG.
skills.intro: Special Delivery - enters Yellow Light Mode, Electro hit.
skills.outro: Escorting - 38% Resonance Skill DMG Amplify to incoming character for 10s or until swap.

bestWeapons: Discord (72.78%, best for Energy Regen/Concerto smoothing)
echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (best - 10% Energy Regen + 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)
Void Thunder (niche - Main DPS Lumi builds)

mainStats.cost3: Electro DMG; Electro DMG > Energy Regen

teams.name: Best Team (Jinhsi)
teams.notes: Buffs Jinhsi's Skill-DMG nukes 38% via Outro; avoid Shorekeeper here since Jinhsi's Forte needs Coordinated Attacks.

teams.name: Best Team (Carlotta)
teams.notes: Carlotta deals almost exclusively Skill DMG, a natural fit, but timing Lumi's Outro against Carlotta's Forte nuke is awkward.

rotation: Intro -> Ultimate -> Skill: Energized Pounce (optional swap-cancel) -> Red Spotlight Basic 1,2,3 (optional swap-cancel) -> Skill: Energized Rebound -> Yellow Light Basic -> Channelled Dash: Glare x6 -> Skill: Energized Pounce -> Echo (swap-cancel) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: fills a unique niche as the only Resonance Skill DMG buffer (relevant for Carlotta/Jinhsi), high mobility and mixed ranged/melee playstyle, but longer field time than most Hybrids and energy-hungry; lacked a truly ideal team at release.
